title: Coverage-Loss Near-Eligibility Allowance: Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) Desk Guidance
content:
A recent denial of Riverbend Medical Hardship Assistance (above 400% FPL) under the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care) raises the coverage-loss discount percent of a Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) account.

**Rule.** The patient's most recent assistance determination, read only among cases in approved, denied, expired or revoked status (a case in submitted, pending-documents or withdrawn status awaits or lacks a determination and is never read), with an award, expiry or revocation dated the same day as a denial taken as the later and the first recorded of two same-day denials taken, sets the coverage-loss near-eligibility allowance when it is a denial whose determination date falls no more than 365 days before the day the discount is posted. A case of the Riverbend Medical Hardship Assistance (above 400% FPL) tier denied as assets above limit adds 10 percentage points to the coverage-loss discount percent; a case of that tier denied as income above limit adds 5 percentage points; any other case, a most recent determination that is not a denial, an older determination or no determination adds none.

## Points of judgement

1. **Read only determined cases.** Approved, denied, expired and revoked cases are read; submitted, pending-documents and withdrawn cases never are.
2. **Pick the most recent.** Latest determination date wins. On the same date, an award, expiry or revocation is later than a denial; of two denials on the same date, the first recorded is taken.
3. **Test the denial.** The allowance needs a denial of the hardship tier for assets above limit (10 points) or income above limit (5 points), dated no more than 365 days before the posting day.

## Boundary and cases (hypothetical)

| Most recent determination | Age on the posting day | Points |
|---|---|---|
| hardship denial, assets above limit | 365 days | 10 |
| hardship denial, assets above limit | 366 days | none |
| hardship denial, income above limit | 30 days | 5 |
| 40% charity discount tier denial, income above limit | 30 days | none |
| hardship denial and an expiry of another case, same day | 30 days | none |
